3343-the-wandering-jew-volume-05.creator: Eugene Sue
3343-the-wandering-jew-volume-05.description: A book by Eugene Sue. "Morok?" said Abbe d'Aigrigny, with surprise. "I thought, on leaving Germany and Switzerland, he had received from Friburg the order to proceed southward. At Nismes, or Avignon, he would at this moment be useful as an agent; for the Protestants begin to move, and we fear a reaction against the Catholics."

Some slight modifications have been effected here and there; but in other respects I have presented a faithful rendering.

54605-nursery-lessons-in-words-of-one-sy.creator: Unknown
54605-nursery-lessons-in-words-of-one-sy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He will not learn to read, though Jane takes so much pains to teach him. See how the leaves of his nice, gay book are all torn, and how he pouts his lips. We hope, as he grows up, he will see his faults, and try to mend.

63637-a-village-in-picardy.creator: Ruth Gaines

77120-the-silver-net.creator: Unknown
77120-the-silver-net.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He was cold at heart and weary and a numbing sense of shame  Made him fearful of the night. Though alone, he felt that hidden in the bushes and the trees  Many eyes were watching him. When he tried to move he wavered, and he fell upon his knees,  And his sight with tears was dim.

arxiv-1909-06585.title: Deep Robotic Grasping Prediction with Hierarchical RGB-D Fusion
arxiv-1909-06585.creator: Yaoxian Song, Jun Wen, Yuejiao Fei, Changbin Yu
arxiv-1909-06585.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Yaoxian Song, Jun Wen, Yuejiao Fei, Changbin Yu. Robotic arm grasping is a fundamental operation in robotic control task goals. Most current methods for robotic grasping focus on RGB-D policy in the table surface scenario or 3D point cloud analysis and inference in the 3D space. Comparing to these methods, we propose a novel real-time multimodal hierarchical encoder-decoder neural network that fuses RGB and depth data to realize robotic humanoid grasping in 3D space with only partial observation.

arxiv-2011-10659.title: Efficient stream-based Max-Min diversification with minimal failure rate
arxiv-2011-10659.creator: Mathilde Fekom, Argyris Kalogeratos
arxiv-2011-10659.description: Abstract The stream-based Max-Min diversification problem concerns the task of selecting a limited number of diverse instances from a data stream. The nature of the problem demands immediate and irrevocable decisions. The set-wise diversity to be maximized is the minimum distance among any pair of the selected instances.

arxiv-2101-11548.title: Modelling the Impact of Scandals: the case of the 2017 French Presidential Election
arxiv-2101-11548.creator: Yassine Bouachrine, Carole Adam
arxiv-2101-11548.description: Abstract This paper proposes an agent-based simulation of a presidential election, inspired by the French 2017 presidential election. The simulation is based on data extracted from polls, media coverage, and Twitter. The main contribution is to consider the impact of scandals and media bashing on the result of the election.

arxiv-2102-08844.title: On two mean square averages of Dirichlet L L -function
arxiv-2102-08844.creator: Neha Elizabeth Thomas, Arya Chandran, K Vishnu Namboothiri
arxiv-2102-08844.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Neha Elizabeth Thomas, Arya Chandran, K Vishnu Namboothiri. Finding the mean square averages of the Dirichlet L L -functions over Dirichlet characters χ \chi of same parity is an active problem in number theory.

arxiv-2204-13874.title: OA-Mine : Open-World Attribute Mining for E-Commerce Products with Weak Supervision DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 Conference: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2022; April 25–29, 2022; Virtual Event, Lyon, France Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2022 (WWW ’22), April 25–29, 2022, Virtual Eve
arxiv-2204-13874.creator: Xinyang Zhang 1 , Chenwei Zhang 2 , Xian Li 2 , Xin Luna Dong 3 Jingbo Shang 4 , Christos Faloutsos 5 , Jiawei Han 1
arxiv-2204-13874.description: Abstract . Automatic extraction of product attributes from their textual descriptions is essential for online shopper experience. One inherent challenge of this task is the emerging nature of e-commerce products — we see new types of products with their unique set of new attributes constantly.

arxiv-2311-04411.title: Validation of tight-binding model in system of two semiconductor single-electron lines coupled electrostatically by Schrödinger formalism *
arxiv-2311-04411.creator: Krzysztof Pomorski 1,2
arxiv-2311-04411.description: Abstract Validation of tight-binding model is given basing on two single-electron lines coupled perturbatively electrostatically in Schrödinger formalism. Scheme for conversion of quantum information from eigenenergy qubits to position based qubits is given. The procedure for determination of system ground is presented.

arxiv-2311-12070.title: FDDM: Unsupervised Medical Image Translation with a Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Model
arxiv-2311-12070.description: Abstract Diffusion models have demonstrated significant potential in producing high-quality images in medical image translation to aid disease diagnosis, localization, and treatment. Nevertheless, current diffusion models have limited success in achieving faithful image translations that can accurately preserve the anatomical structures of medical images, especially for unpaired datasets.

arxiv-2311-13226.title: Robot at the Mirror: Learning to Imitate via Associating Self-supervised Models
arxiv-2311-13226.creator: Andrej Lúčny, Kristína Malinovská, Igor Farkaš
arxiv-2311-13226.description: Abstract We introduce an approach to building a custom model from ready-made self-supervised models via their associating instead of training and fine-tuning. We demonstrate it with an example of a humanoid robot looking at the mirror and learning to detect the 3D pose of its own body from the image it perceives.

arxiv-2312-04562.title: Glassy word problems: ultraslow relaxation, Hilbert space jamming, and computational complexity
arxiv-2312-04562.creator: Shankar Balasubramanian, Sarang Gopalakrishnan, Alexey Khudorozhkov, Ethan Lake
arxiv-2312-04562.description: Abstract We introduce a family of local models of dynamics based on “word problems” from computer science and group theory, for which we can place rigorous lower bounds on relaxation timescales. These models can be regarded either as random circuit or local Hamiltonian dynamics, and include many familiar examples of constrained dynamics as special cases.

arxiv-2408-15067.title: New ultracool dwarf candidates from multi-epoch WISE data
arxiv-2408-15067.creator: S. Karpov, O. Malkov, A. Avdeeva
arxiv-2408-15067.description: Abstract Context. Thirty years after the discovery of brown dwarfs, the search for these objects continues, particularly in the vicinity of the Sun. Objects near the Sun are characterized by large proper motions, making them seen as fast-moving objects. While the Gaia DR3 catalogue is a comprehensive source of proper motions, it lacks the depth needed for discovering fainter objects.

arxiv-2501-05408.title: Tempo : Compiled Dynamic Deep Learning with Symbolic Dependence Graphs
arxiv-2501-05408.creator: Pedro F. Silvestre, Peter Pietzuch
arxiv-2501-05408.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pedro F. Silvestre, Peter Pietzuch. Deep learning (DL) algorithms are often defined in terms of temporal relationships : a tensor at one timestep may depend on tensors from earlier or later timesteps. Such dynamic dependencies (and corresponding dynamic tensor shapes) are difficult to express and optimize: while eager DL systems support such dynamism, they cannot apply compiler-based optimizations; graph-based systems require static tensor shapes, which forces users to pad tensors or break-up programs into multiple static graphs.

arxiv-2508-10919.title: Human-AI collaboration or obedient and often clueless AI in instruct, serve, repeat dynamics?
arxiv-2508-10919.creator: Mohammed Saqr, Kamila Misiejuk, Sonsoles López-Pernas
arxiv-2508-10919.description: Abstract While research on human-AI collaboration exists, it mainly examined language learning and used traditional counting methods with little attention to evolution and dynamics of collaboration on cognitively demanding tasks. This study examines human-AI interactions while solving a complex problem.

arxiv-2604-15296.title: Unity and Diversity of Intracellular pH Maintenance Mechanisms
arxiv-2604-15296.creator: Guillaume Terradot, Vincent Danos

pmc-10507849.title: Successful delivery after in vitro fertilization-embryo transfer in a woman with metachronous primary cancer of ovary and endometrium: a case report
pmc-10507849.creator: Yichang Tian, Yu Liang, Xiaokui Yang
pmc-10507849.description: BackgroundThe appearance of malignancies at various times in the same individual, excluding metastases of the initial primary cancer, is termed multiple primary cancers. Double primary gynecological cancers cause inevitable damage to female reproductive function, and the preservation of fertility in such patients remains a challenging issue as relatively few cases have been reported.

pmc-10641477.title: Histopathological growth pattern of liver metastases as an independent marker of metastatic behavior in different primary cancers
pmc-10641477.creator: Ali Bohlok, François Richard, Valerio Lucidi, Antoine El Asmar, Pieter Demetter, Ligia Craciun, Denis Larsimont, Alain Hendlisz, Jean Luc Van Laethem, Luc Dirix, Christine Desmedt, Peter Vermeulen, Vincent Donckier
pmc-10641477.description: Surgical resection can lead to prolonged survival in patients with isolated liver metastases (LM) from various primary cancers. However, there are currently no validated predictive markers to discriminate between these oligo/argometastatic patients, who will benefit from surgery, and those with diffuse metastatic behavior in whom surgery will be futile.

pmc-11536772.title: Immunosuppression and transplantation-related characteristics affect the difference between eGFR equations based on creatinine compared to cystatin C in kidney transplant recipients
pmc-11536772.creator: Lukas Weidmann, Catherine Laux, Kai Castrezana Lopez, Dusan Harmacek, Britta George, Seraina von Moos, Thomas Schachtner
pmc-11536772.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionPrevious studies show heterogeneity when applying estimated glomerular filtration (eGFR) equations to kidney transplant recipients (KTRs). However, research on the impact of transplantation-related characteristics on eGFR equations using creatinine (eGFRcr) compared to cystatin C (eGFRcys) is scarce.MethodsWe conducted a comprehensive analysis with three eGFRcr equations (Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) 2009, European Kidney Function Consortium (EKFC) 2021, kidney recipient specific-glomerular filtration rate KRS-GFR) 2023), comparing them to two eGFRcys (CKD-EPI 2012 and EKFC 2023) in 596 KTRs.

pmc-11564133.title: Advanced Halal Authentication Methods and Technology for Addressing Non-Compliance Concerns in Halal Meat and Meat Products Supply Chain: A Review
pmc-11564133.creator: Artnice Mega Fathima, Laila Rahmawati, Anjar Windarsih, Suratno
pmc-11564133.description: Religious beliefs have a significant impact on consumer preferences, particularly in relation to food choices. Islam, like other religions, imposes specific dietary guidelines, notably regarding meat and meat products. However, ensuring compliance with halal standards across the entire meat and meat products supply chain presents considerable challenges.

pmc-11648787.title: Surgical management of skull base and spinal chordomas: A case series with comprehensive review of the literature
pmc-11648787.creator: Sarah Lee, Nahom Teferi, Juan Vivanco-Suarez, Ajmain Chowdhury, Stephen Glennon, Kyle Kato, Tyson Matern, Kathryn L Eschbacher, Michael Petronek, Patrick Hitchon
pmc-11648787.description: BackgroundChordomas are rare, slow growing, locally aggressive malignant bone tumors that arise from remnants of the embryonic notochord with variable presenting symptoms depending on tumor location.MethodsAll patients with craniospinal chordoma managed at our institution between 1982 and 2023 were retrospectively reviewed. Demographics, tumor characteristics, clinical course and treatment, and long-term neurological and survival outcomes were collected.

pmc-11692322.title: ORAL CARE IS A NECESSITY NOT A LUXURY: POLICIES THAT HELP OR HINDER ORAL CARE FOR OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11692322.creator: Kayla Gallant, Katrina Reid, Joan Ilardo, Angela Zell
pmc-11692322.description: We interviewed fifteen stakeholders including state-level policy officials, medical practitioners, dental advocacy organizations, and educators to identify factors influencing oral care provision for older adults in residential settings. The interviews were conducted by two second-year medical students under the supervision of a Ph.D. social worker and a Doctor of Public Health. Analysis of interview transcripts followed grounded theory methodology.

pmc-12406779.title: Understanding the implementation of antimicrobial stewardship in Utah community pharmacies
pmc-12406779.creator: Tariq A Mosleh, April Clements, Devin Beard, Angela Weil, Christina Radloff, Charisse Schenk, Sarah Rigby, Susan Cheever
pmc-12406779.description: ObjectivesAntimicrobial stewardship (AS) is essential to optimize antibiotic use and combat resistance. This study evaluated the implementation of AS activities in community pharmacies across Utah and assessed pharmacists’ understanding of AS principles, current practices and barriers. This study also aimed to increase community pharmacists’ awareness of preventing drug-resistant infections.

pmc-12630923.title: CAN reveals rapid intensification features of spring cyclones over Mongolian plateau and Northeast China plain
pmc-12630923.creator: Ruipeng Sun, Yina Diao, Jianping Li
pmc-12630923.description: Traditional composite analysis in cyclone studies, which compares variables at fixed grid points relative to the cyclone center, is limited by spatial misalignments caused by cyclone rotation. This misalignment blurs composite results and hinders accurate structural analysis. To address this issue, we propose the Cyclone Alignment Network (CAN) method.

pmc-12653241.title: Functions of N-Glycosylation-Related Endoplasmic Reticulum Proteins in the Development and Virulence of Plant Pathogens
pmc-12653241.creator: Yanxin Wang, Kaijie Chen, Yu Zhang, Zimeng Zhang, Zi Tao, Xianfeng Ye, Ulrich Kück
pmc-12653241.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). N-glycosylation, a crucial eukaryotic post-translational modification, has been extensively studied for its significance in the physiology and virulence processes of plant pathogens over the last decade. This review systematically analyzes the functions of N-glycosylation-related endoplasmic reticulum (ER) proteins in regulating plant pathogen processes, including mycelial growth, conidial development, host penetration as well as colonization, pathogenicity, cell wall integrity and host immune evasion.

pmc-13082464.title: multiDEGGs: Single or Multiomic Differential Network Analysis for Biomarker Discovery and Feature Engineering for Predictive Modeling
pmc-13082464.creator: Elisabetta Sciacca, Susan S. Wang, Costantino Pitzalis, Myles J Lewis
pmc-13082464.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights Traditional gene expression analysis leaves researchers with hundreds of “significant” genes but no clear biological story. pmc-13392600.title: Response to letter from Fontaine et al
pmc-13392600.creator: Nupur Singh, Anna Conner, Zachary Nahmias

pmc-13532150.title: Double Thionation of 4‐Dimethylaminophthalimide Leads to the Development of a Highly Effective Photosensitizer
pmc-13532150.creator: Chris Acquah, Eric Lee, Sourav Kanti Seth, Reshma Mathew, Rubej R. Khan, Steffen Jockusch, Shudan Yang, Han Xiao, Carlos E. Crespo‐Hernández
pmc-13532150.description: Transforming existing biocompatible fluorophores through thionation presents a compelling strategy to modulate their photodynamic properties while circumventing the limitations associated with heavy atoms, such as metals or halogens. This approach integrates sulfur atoms that enhance intersystem crossing (ISC) to the triplet state via spin‐orbit coupling, positioning these photosensitizers as suitable candidates for photodynamic therapy applications.

pmc-13586669.title: Clinical Spectrum of Reversible Cerebral Vasoconstriction Syndrome With and Without Angiographic Vasoconstriction: A Retrospective Study of 84 Hospitalized Patients
pmc-13586669.creator: Katsuya Takeuchi, Shoji Kikui, Yoshiki Matsumoto, Kenji Murakata, Hanako Sugiyama, Kuniko Ota, Daisuke Danno, Yoshihiro Kashiwaya, Takao Takeshima
pmc-13586669.description: ObjectiveTo determine whether patients with reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (RCVS) without demonstrable vasoconstriction differ clinically from those with angiographically confirmed vasoconstriction.MethodsWe retrospectively studied consecutive patients with RCVS hospitalized at a tertiary headache center in Japan between February 2011 and March 2026. Patients were classified according to the presence or absence of angiographically demonstrable vasoconstriction on magnetic resonance angiography.

pmc-13637497.title: Rapid Preparation of Carrier-Free Self-Assembled Aqueous Nanoformulations of Ten BCS Class II Drugs, Propofol, and Hydroxyapatite Using FAST Nanotechnology
pmc-13637497.creator: Stephen Hsu, Hongfang Yu, Archith Philip, Amani Mouna, Brendan Marshall, Douglas Dickinson
pmc-13637497.description: Poor aqueous solubility remains a major barrier to the development, repurposing, and improved delivery of clinically important small-molecule drugs. This formulation problem is especially relevant to Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS) Class II drugs, for which dissolution rather than membrane permeability may limit absorption and translational testing.
